notes:
## Changes

- Media Walls: New wall opens Edit wall on an empty wall. It's added to your walls when you save it.
- Edit wall: a new Add scenes panel. Search by scene name, folder, performer or tag, then press + to put a scene in the first empty zone (or the queue), or drag it onto a zone or into the queue.
- Edit wall: hover over a search result to see its screenshot large, its five-frame strip, and its folder, length, resolution and size.
- Edit wall: drag scene tiles from the main window straight into the wall while Edit wall is open. A selection comes along together.
- Edit wall: only scenes on connected drives are offered or accepted. The panel says how many were left out.
- Edit wall no longer locks the main window while it's open.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
